# vite-react-tailwind-lint

> A Vite starter for React and Tailwind CSS with ESLint, Stylelint, HTMLHint, Prettier, Vitest, Husky pre-commit hooks and a tagged-release pipeline already wired up. MIT licensed.

- Site: https://vitereact.marcopontili.com/
- Repository: https://github.com/marcop135/vite-react-tailwind-lint
- Author: Marco Pontili, https://marcopontili.com

## When to use it

Use it to start a small single-page React app without configuring linting, formatting, tests and CI by hand. It needs Node.js 22.22.2 or newer.

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/marcop135/vite-react-tailwind-lint.git my-app
cd my-app && npm install
npm run dev
```
